evidence: Tagged with Wallet label and modifies src/wallet/migration.cpp, src/wallet/db.cpp, and related wallet database files.
rationale: Prevents wallet corruption and data loss during legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration. Currently, migration deletes the original BerkeleyDB database before writing the SQLite database, meaning unexpected failures leave partially migrated databases or crash the node; additionally, stale SQLite journals could overwrite pages of the newly migrated database.
